title: "Exploring a Cargo Project Structure"

# Exploring a Cargo Project Structure
Initialize a new project with Cargo:

```bash
cargo new desk_service --bin
cd desk_service
```

### Standard Directory Layout

```text
desk_service/
├── Cargo.lock       # Exact resolved dependency graph
├── Cargo.toml       # Manifest file: project metadata & dependencies
├── src/
│   └── main.rs      # Binary root entry point
└── target/          # Build artifacts and compilation cache (gitignored)
```

### The Cargo.toml Manifest

```toml
[package]
name = "desk_service"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
```

The `edition = "2024"` flag configures the language edition. Rust guarantees backwards compatibility across editions through epoch-based stability.
